reviews.author: Yudelka Rod
reviews.text: If you need to fix a flat or any other car issue, definitely come to these guys. I came in to fix a flat tire and had a great experience from start to finish. They were professional, fast, and reliable. The service was done quickly, and everything was handled efficiently without any hassle. It’s hard to find places you can trust, but this is one of them. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: JULIA NABIULLINA
reviews.text: I’m so happy I found them! The dealership (ugh) kept charging me a lot for many things making me come back and the last job was quoted $1200, whereas this shop fixed it for $120- it wasn’t what the dealership said. Finally I’m feeling safe and covered for my car matters! I’ll keep coming back here from now on. Thank you 5 Brothers Auto Repair!

reviews.author: Chris Rosequist
reviews.text: They do a good job.. Sometimes. My car had a power steering issue. They put a band-aid on it so that the wheel could turn smoothly. Still made noise and leaked. The guy said it should stop, but if not, something else is bad.. Ya think?

reviews.author: Googlereviewer10
reviews.text: WORST SHOP AROUND. THEY RIPPED ME OFF MULTIPLE TIMES. I’ve taken countless vehicles here to EFRAIN and almost every time he has had me have to come back the next day due to my car not running right or the previous problem not being fixed. There has even been times where this shop did not put back things correctly on my car after taking it apart. Anyways, I recently called back because I took my truck there last week for a fluid leak. Apparently EFRAÌN told me he fixed it and the next week it’s pissing out fluid . I called back for them to look at it again and EFRAÌN told me he is too busy and cannot help me. , even though he never fixed the problem prior to this and charged me a FORTUNE. SAVE YOURSELF. There are so many other shops that are reputable in the hackettstown area. Don’t go here. I already have found a better cheaper shop.

reviews.author: Susan Louth
reviews.text: Quality work, fair prices, honest and fixed the same day. I dropped my car off and they drove me home and picked me up when car was done! I highly recommend Five Brothers!

reviews.author: Connor
reviews.text: Had a grinding noise coming from under my car that I thought was a heat shield and it turned out that my break pad had sheered off, had me back on the road in an hour and told me exactly what it would cost before starting to work, great guys!

reviews.author: Rick Curley
reviews.text: These guys go Above and Beyond. Their service is fantastic and rates are more then fair. They are the ONLY shop I let work on all my company trucks and personal vehicles. Give them a shot, you won't be sorry.

reviews.author: Lorena Lara
reviews.text: I went to get my oil pan fixed, they didn’t put oil, I was told they did. My engine broke down. The worst experience. Unethical.

reviews.author: Virginia Martelli
reviews.text: I broke down on the highway Saturday evening an hour and a half away from home. They went out of their way to help me and got my car fixed that day so I could get home. I am extremely grateful.

reviews.author: R. Alfonso
reviews.text: This auto repair offer the best quality parts and excellent experience mechanics, with affordable prices. I highly recommend this shop..

reviews.author: Gene Mackowiak
reviews.text: Starter replacement bammm ...4 hr turn around and on the road again! Perfect 10 service...highly recomended! #WRNJ ROCKS!
